rationale: The common replay materializer is already a single shared implementation and is repository-local/deterministic.
Each phase requires its own local workspace immediately before appending phase-specific migrations and starting isolated Supabase.
Cross-workflow artifact/cache sharing would add producer workflow, artifact upload/download, Actions run coupling, permissions, expiry, and failure modes.
Observed materialization cost is negligible relative to isolated Supabase runtime, so added orchestration would increase CI complexity without meaningful runtime savings.

observedReference.note: Single successful Phase 8G reference run; used as an order-of-magnitude CI cost check, not a universal benchmark.

allowedFutureChange: Re-evaluate only if measured replay materialization becomes materially expensive or a shared artifact is independently required for correctness.
